entities.name: Borys Oliynyk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Borys Illich Oliynyk was a Soviet and Ukrainian writer and politician who was a People's Deputy of Ukraine from 1990 to 2006. Oliynyk was one of the leaders of the People's Movement of Ukraine and later a founder of the Communist Party of Ukraine.
